increment_identity: 48 adds the only manager_split.rs change between 671 and 48. Exact parent f24 and 671 manager_split.rs both have SHA256 b70b7e4ad08d737825a4a1892cc321098099c5234d31484cb014b3acac312929. This review inspects the new source rather than assuming the old verdict applies.

prior_findings.evidence: The same application screen painter gains SplitAlert plus special saved-mode identity, detail metadata, and hint painters. HardCases now calls this painter instead of draw_historical_manager. There is still no shared Tree/Menu/Button implementation, update/measure/state contract, stable item keys or typed action output. New alert paths use literal Construct/daemon/domain wording and fixed x41/x31 positions. Moving another scenario into this painter extends rather than removes the prohibited mechanism.

Workspace selection still searches the literal payments-platform and fabricates that name if absent. Zero actual refresh age still becomes three seconds. The exact 120x40, paused-motion, Returning/HardCases and selected-row gates remain. Capability/accent selectors remain on neighboring historical alternatives. Application account wrapping remains fixed at 58 characters. New discovery-error extraction does not correct these sources.

prior_findings.status: persists; directly reproduced against exact parent and candidate
prior_findings.evidence: The real app registers LAUNCH at Rect { x: 4, y: 35, width: 16, height: 1 }; the correction painter displays it at (42,36). Clicking (44,36) fails to open the real agent picker on both revisions. Standalone public painter still has zero focus entries. A positive control clicks LAUNCH through its real registered bounds and opens the picker on both revisions. The action is available; only the painter places its visible button elsewhere.

useful_changes_to_retain_in_correct_owne: Computing expandable from visible instances is legitimate application view-data preparation. A generic shared Tree should receive stable item keys and child availability rather than paint a special saved-screen marker.

Extracting discovery error text and stale-daemon state from the world is legitimate domain mapping. Supply these facts to generic Notice/Status/Hint components with semantic styles and typed application actions.
Using the existing shared truncate_middle for Saved-mode labels is an improvement over raw labels. It does not provide layout, clipping, state or interaction ownership for the rest of the screen.
new_alert_path_review: No captured ANSI or expected screenshot import was added by this increment. The defect is a scenario-selected correction renderer with fixed geometry and domain-specific alert/header/footer pixels. Borrowed data and removal of the old call-site function name do not make the mechanism reusable.
limits_and_unrun_checks: The full 318-test Jackin/Feedback native suite was not repeated because unchanged integration failures and the direct public API/source blockers already establish HOLD. The prior 671 native result is supplementary history, not a claimed run at 48.
No new strict Clippy, whole-workspace formatting/test gate, required CI, frozen CLI/Tuiscotti capture or independent zero-cell admission was performed.
The fixed frozen source remains 4169783ae883788186d161af09ba9c481bd84e5c. No references or expected output were changed.

Public consumer compilation and adapted behavior checks use exact detached parent/candidate copies and distinct targets. No author/parent source or prior fixture was edited; no commits or pushes were made.

An initial attempt to launch the fact runner occurred before worktree setup had written its script and returned file-not-found. It was an orchestration error, not a product result; the actual successful test invocations and their red outcomes are preserved separately.
The existing shared manager/tree block contract is queued for real component adoption. This review does not approve the current painter or suggest moving it back into the application.
